defect.root_cause: The Statcast client converted an unavailable dependency or transport exception to an empty DataFrame. The feature engine interpreted that empty result as an empty player pool and constructed league-average hitter profiles. Separately, field-level league substitutions were not carried with the values consumed downstream.
defect.old_failure: Source loss and source-field loss could be indistinguishable from legitimate player-level fallback evidence.
defect.repair: Unavailable, failed, non-tabular, empty, identity-deficient, or required-column-deficient Statcast payloads now terminate before feature construction. Requests intersecting May 2026 terminate before a source call. Valid-source player/field substitutions retain exact field-level fallback lineage through feature serialization and input-health reporting. Contradictory lineage terminates at the shared probability-input validator.

reconstruction.reason: The repair changes failure handling and provenance only. Valid source-derived feature values and probability coefficients are unchanged, so rebuilding historical features would create no truthful new model evidence and could improperly reuse spent outcomes.

mutation_proof: transport exception cannot become an empty player pool
empty, non-tabular, identity-deficient, and required-column-deficient payloads terminate
May-intersecting requests terminate before source/dependency access
fallback lineage survives feature-store round trip
a league fallback mutated to claim observed status terminates at consumption
verification.valid_input_non_regression: Valid Statcast fixtures preserve measured batter identity, xwOBA/xBA/xSLG, shared barrel/hard-hit counts and rates, distribution attachment, and downstream simulation tests.

hashes.data_feature_hash_reason: No permissible data or feature artifact was read or rebuilt for this integrity-only repair.

promotion.reason: Integrity correctness is proven, but no fresh independent performance evidence exists and no proper-score improvement is claimed.

single_highest_value_next_action: Complete SI-007/SI-011 by binding every rich-feature override that reaches the shared PA probability path to source, player identity, pregame cutoff, sample count, denominator, fallback reason, and immutable source hash; reject contradictory or lineage-free overrides before any fresh model candidate is fitted.
